    Nested quotients #

    Let I ≤ J be proper zero ideals of a ray category C, A = C/I and B = C/J. An arrow of A is new when its lift lies in J. Old paths of A are paths of B (toB), and conversely (toA). Hence cycle-freeness and interval-finiteness of B give the old-path hypotheses of cycleFree_of_step and intervalFinite_of_step for A (oldCycle_trivial, oldInterval_finite), and if B is simply connected and every new arrow e satisfies a nonzero relation e uₑ = u with old paths uₑ, u, then A is simply connected (isCoboundary_of_nested).
